# geometric-perfect

The logo rebuilt on its exact grid: straight edges, true angles, mirrored sprocket holes. This is the version the whole kit uses.

## Folders

| Folder | What is in it |
|---|---|
| [`1-bit/`](1-bit/) | One-bit (pure black and white, no grey) versions, for stamps, laser cutting and fax-like printing. |
| [`pdf/`](pdf/) | Vector files (PDF) for print. |
| [`png/`](png/) | PNG files from 512 to 8192 px wide, transparent background. |
| [`previews/`](previews/) | Previews on dark and light backgrounds. |
| [`svg/`](svg/) | Vector files (SVG): clean shapes that scale to any size. |
